Variants.Content: In 209 BC, during his fifth consulship, elderly Fabius Maximus orchestrated the recapture of Tarentum. Suborning a Bruttian mercenary officer who opened a neglected sector of the walls, Fabius stormed the city and slaughtered the Punic garrison. Arriving only five miles away to find the city lost, Hannibal sighed bitterly: 'The Romans have found another Hannibal; we have lost Tarentum even as we won it.'
